scope: Proposition 9.12 (Canonical coordinates and independence) of the manuscript “Canonical conformal limits of subcritical FK planar maps” (preprints/Canonical-conformal-limits-of-subcritical-FK-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e7dab39caf778176), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 82-83. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Before three-mark normalization, conditional on the reference quantum surface, Γ has the fixed unmarked whole-plane CLEκ law. Let T be the Möbius map taking three fresh independent quantum-area marks to 0, 1, ∞. Then TΓ has that same conditional law given the normalized embedded quantum sphere. 82 On an extraction for which ϕn ◦H−1 n → f uniformly, the canonical loop collections Γn = ϕn(ˆ︁ Γn) converge to fΓ. Here f = T or f = r ◦ T, where r(z) = z; this is the same orientation alternative as for all other retained observations.
